# SISU Training Academy

> Small-group strength and conditioning for athletes aged 10 to 18 in Hawthorn East, Melbourne, Australia. Every athlete is tested (vertical jump, broad jump, 10 m sprint) at the start and end of each program, and parents get both results. Training runs out of Grouse Strength Studio. SISU is owned by Ben Plowman (founder) and Josh Chiodo.

Key facts:

- Ages: 10 to 18, any sport. The Blueprint is for athletes 15 and over.
- Location: Grouse Strength Studio, Hawthorn East, VIC.
- Contact: 0437 693 699 · sisutrainingacademy@gmail.com. First step is a 15-minute phone call.
- Best results so far (five-day holiday programs): broad jump +35 cm, vertical jump +21 cm, 10 m sprint −0.25 s.
- Rated 5.0 on Google from 11 reviews.
- Ben Plowman's basketball skills coaching is run separately from SISU. Contact Ben on 0437 693 699 for availability.

## Programs

- [Term 4](https://sisutrainingacademy.com/term.html): 10 weekly coached sessions, 5 Oct – 18 Dec 2026. Group (max 8) $450, Mon–Thu 4–5pm or Sun 11am–12pm. Advanced (max 4) $650, Sun 1–2pm, for athletes with a full term or 10 sessions of S&C behind them. Includes testing, re-testing and a progress report.
- [The Blueprint](https://sisutrainingacademy.com/blueprint.html): online program for athletes 15+ who train at their own gym. 1, 2 or 3 days a week, $220 / $280 / $340. Starts with a foundation session; progression sessions every 5–7 weeks are $120.

## About

- [About SISU](https://sisutrainingacademy.com/about.html): what the name means, the coaches, club partners (Hawthorn Magic, Balwyn Blazers) and parent FAQ.
- [Contact](https://sisutrainingacademy.com/contact.html): phone, email, map and message form.
